title: Bouncing Projectiles(PBOSB for Fabric)
description: Projectiles now bounce off slime blocks, adding new mechanics for combat and traps.
body:
Bouncing Projectiles changes the fundamentals of combat and gameplay by allowing projectiles to bounce off slime blocks instead of stopping on impact.

Arrows, snowballs, eggs, and other throwable entities will now bounce when they hit slime blocks, opening up new possibilities for traps and combat strategies. Whether you're designing trick shots, defensive systems, or just experimenting, this mod makes slime blocks more interactive than ever.

(Inspired by PBOSB mod by CAS_ual_TY)
